Our Story

It Started With a Register

Yash first saw Ayushi at office onboarding — and somehow left without her name. So he found the only honest source there was: the onboarding register.

One honest conversation became many. Better communication became a habit — and habit became love. The kind that is mutual, that never leaves the other empty, and that helps each other bloom.
